    16	# The projective closed-immersion criterion for a complete linear system
    17	
    18	The fixed-basis projective morphism is finite and injective on points. At
    19	closed points, tangent separation supplies maximal-ideal generation and the

    Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite k _
  exact RingEquiv.ofBijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k x)
